sections.title: 1. Best Digital Transformation Bank – South Asia (2023)

location.heading: 1. Best Digital Transformation Bank – South Asia (2023)

blocks.text:
Awarded by: Asian Banking & Finance Magazine
Highlight: Recognized for pioneering digital onboarding, robust mobile app (ZX Bank Asia), and adoption of AI chatbot "Zia" across all operating countries.

Awarded by: South Asian Sustainable Finance Forum
Highlight: Honored for innovative green financing projects supporting Bhutan’s hydropower and Nepal’s solar ventures, advancing ESG goals in banking.

Awarded by: Sri Lanka Banking Excellence Council
Highlight: Commended for tailored SME lending solutions and remittance services benefiting entrepreneurs and small businesses.

Awarded by: Bangladesh Microfinance Association
Highlight: Celebrated for expanding access to digital banking, microfinance, and financial literacy in rural and underserved regions.

sections.title: 5. Best Women’s Banking Initiative – South Asia (2023)

location.heading: 5. Best Women’s Banking Initiative – South Asia (2023)

blocks.text:
Awarded by: Women in Banking & Finance Network
Highlight: Recognized for specialized micro-loan programs and financial empowerment projects for women-led enterprises.

sections.title: 6. Top NRI Services Provider – Bhutan & Nepal Corridor (2023)

location.heading: 6. Top NRI Services Provider – Bhutan & Nepal Corridor (2023)

blocks.text:
Awarded by: Asia Cross-Border Payments Council
Highlight: Appreciated for seamless, fast remittance corridors and superior NRI account services connecting families across borders.

For more about ZX Bank’s accolades and recent announcements, visit:
